cleavage agent: trypsin as the enzyme with up to two missed cleavages allowed
enrichment method: RNA pull-down and mass spectrometry assay were conducted to identify its interacting proteins
labeling: Proteins were identified and quantified using the Proteome Discoverer Software 2.4
ptm: carbamidomethylation (C) fixed; oxidation (M) variable; acetylation (protein N-terminus) variable
carbamidomethylation (C) was set as a fixed modification; oxidation (M) and acetylation (protein N-terminus) were set as variable modifications
